purpose: Teach: 明子/大介/康弘/ナターシャ/ミミ/目新しい/マジメ/思ひ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の明子さんとお茶されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that regular customer came in with her friend Akiko. They had tea together.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Gentle pacing. The warmth of noticing and sharing something small about someone. No rush.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様の大介くんを連れていらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer brought her grandson Daisuke with her today.
lines.style: Soft, steady delivery. A smile in the voice — the kind of detail that matters when you notice it. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お父様のお名前が康弘さんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer mentioned her father's name is Yasuhiro.
lines.style: Gentle curiosity in the voice. Sharing a small fact with care, as if tucking it into memory. Light and unforced.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ロシア人のナターシャさんとご来店だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she came in with a Russian woman named Natasha the other day.
lines.style: Bright interest in the voice. A detail that stands out — noticed and worth mentioning. Warm, conversational pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、オペラのミミ役の名アリアを語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer talked about Mimi's aria from La Bohème. She really knew it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly reverent. Leaning into the beauty of what was shared. Slower, more careful with the words.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、店内が目新しい雰囲気でいいって仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she said the café has such a nice new feel to it.
lines.style: Pleased, understated. The satisfaction of hearing a compliment and passing it along without making too much of it. Even tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「マジメに仕事を続けてきた」って語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer told me she's been working with real dedication for years.
lines.style: Respectful, sincere. Slight weight on the words — recognizing something serious being shared. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、古い書物の「思ひ」、つまり「思い」を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, she was reading an old book. One of those texts with the old character 思ひ — thinking, feeling, you know.
lines.style: Gentle, slightly wondering. A small pause around the explanation, like sharing something quietly precious. Soft ending.
